age.about: Changes skin aging and face proportions only, not hair or height. Lines appear from olderAdult_25 up; pick by wrinkles visible in the photo.

presets.child: toddler: very round, chubby cheeks, short nose, smooth skin
presets.child_75: young child: round chubby face, short nose, smooth skin
presets.child_50: child: round face, cheeks still full, smooth skin
presets.child_25: older child / preteen: face slightly longer than child_50, smooth skin
presets.adult: teen to about 30: smooth skin, no lines; default choice for young adults
presets.olderAdult_25: about 30-45: faint under-eye lines and soft smile folds
presets.olderAdult_50: about 45-60: visible under-eye bags and nose-to-mouth folds, faint crow's feet
presets.olderAdult_75: about 60-70: clear crow's feet, deeper smile folds, slightly sagging cheeks
presets.olderAdult: 70+: deep wrinkles around eyes and mouth, sagging jowls

armthickness.about: Only visible in poses that show the body (hands_on_hips, yearbook, ...).

chest.about: Only visible in poses that show the body.

presets.medium: small bust visible under the top

earrings_left.about: Set earrings_left and earrings_right to the same id for a matching pair. Earrings are only visible when the hairstyle leaves the ears uncovered. Studs are tiny at sticker size; drops and hoops read clearly. Default color is Silver; use .color=Gold for gold.

eyebrows.about: Id = shape_arch_weight. Shape: even = same thickness end to end; willowLeaf = thickest in the middle, tapering at both ends; doubleCurve = flat inner part then a kinked, rising tail (S-like); tadpole = thick rounded inner head tapering to a thin tail. Arch: rounded = smooth curve; angled = peaked arch with a corner over the outer iris. Weight: thin / medium / thick stroke.

presets.even_rounded_thick: thick uniform band, smooth arc; bold full brows

eyelashes.about: Most styles only read up close; for a typical male photo keep natural_thin, for visible mascara or lash extensions pick a spread or cat style.

eyes.about: Id = size_tilt[_tapered]. Size is how open the eye is: large = big round eye with white showing around the iris; medium = average almond; small = narrow, lids cover the top and bottom of the iris. Tilt: straight = level corners; upturned = outer corners lift; downturned = outer corners droop (sleepy/gentle). _tapered = heavier upper lid lying low over the iris, a hooded or monolid look common in East and Southeast Asian faces. Judge from a relaxed, non-smiling part of the photo if possible: smiling narrows real eyes.

eyewear.about: Id = shape[_wire|_rimless]: no suffix = thick plastic frame, _wire = thin metal frame, _rimless = frameless. eyewear.color paints the frame (Silver/Gold suit metal frames; Black, Brown, Clear suit plastic; color .shade below 0 darkens, e.g. Silver -0.6 is gunmetal gray, Blue -0.7 is a deep blue, and Blue at 0 is a bright saturated blue, so for muted blue-gray frames use Silver with a negative shade). eyewear.color2 is the lens tint: Clear for prescription glasses, Dark for sunglasses.

facialhair.about: Id = mustache_beard[_shadow]. Pick the mustache and the beard separately, then join them; add _shadow for stubble on the bare skin. Mustaches: none; basic = chevron mustache: thick, straight, covers the upper lip edge to edge (the everyday mustache); english = long thin mustache stretched out wide and curling up at the tips; handlebar = medium mustache with tips curled up and in like handlebars; horseshoe = thin mustache that runs down both sides of the mouth to the jaw, an upside-down U; pencil = very thin short line just above the lip, with a gap in the middle; walrus = big bushy mustache covering the whole upper lip and drooping over it; wildWest = thick wide mustache with downturned then flicked-up tips. Beards: none; shadow = stubble shadow only over cheeks, jaw, chin and upper lip; five o'clock shadow; soulPatch = small patch of hair just under the lower lip; anchor = small pointed chin beard below the lip, not on the jaw; goatee = rounded beard around the chin and mouth only, cheeks bare; brett = thin chinstrap line along the jaw meeting a small chin strip; muttonChops = thick hair down the sides of the face to the jaw corners; chin shaved; basic = short neat boxed beard covering jaw and chin (despite the label 'short', it reads as a full trimmed beard); ducktail = full beard ending in a ragged point below the chin; full = full beard, longer, rounded bottom below the chin; broad = big long beard, squared off well below the chin. Beard coverage, least first: shadow < soulPatch < anchor < goatee < brett < muttonChops < basic < ducktail < full < broad. Set facialhair.color to match the hair (Gray for a gray beard).

hair.about: Id = texture_length_height_style. Texture: straight, wavy, looseCurls (ringlets), curly (springy coils), tightCurls (afro-textured), microBraid, braid, locks, cornRows; short/buzzed ids are close-cropped. Length: short (above ears), medium (chin to shoulder), long (past shoulders, or pulled up into a bun/ponytail). Height: down = falls flat, mid = some lift, up = lifted or pulled up, back = combed or pulled back from the face. Many long 'up'/'back' styles show the ears and forehead from the front; 'down' styles usually cover the ears. Colors: see the hair.color looks; hair.shade below 0 is darker, above 0 lighter.

colors.Gray: light silver gray at 0; -0.5 is mid gray (salt and pepper), +0.5 nearly white
colors.Maple: medium chestnut brown; use this for ordinary brown hair
colors.Soft Black: dark brown (it looks clearly brown in renders, not black); use Black for black hair
colors.Black: black; the right pick for black hair, including East and Southeast Asian hair
colors.Golden Brown: ginger / copper orange (despite the label 'Dark Brown'); use for ginger or strawberry hair, not brown

head.about: Face shape. Id = shape_size, where size is NOT overall head size: it is how wide and full the cheeks and jaw are (small = narrow, youthful; large = broad, fleshy lower face). Shape is the jaw/chin outline. Compare the photo's jaw width to its forehead width first. Skin: head.color sets lightness (Extended 1 lightest ... Extended 3 deepest). head.shade does NOT make skin lighter or darker: it shifts the undertone at about the same brightness, -0.5 = golden/olive/yellow, 0 = neutral, +0.5 = pink/rosy. To go lighter or darker, change head.color by one step instead.

Fullness: thin (narrow line, upper lip barely visible), medium, thick (full, plump lower lip). Most men read as oval_thin or oval_medium; full lips as *_thick.

nose.about: Differences are subtle at sticker size. Button = round ball tip; triangle = narrow bridge widening to the nostrils, with a defined bridge in profile; snub = short, flat, wide nostrils; upturned = tip tilted up. Size = width of the tip and nostrils. A wide, flat nose with broad nostrils: snub_medium/large. A narrow prominent nose with a visible bridge: triangle_*.

presets.small: small round button tip; cute, minimal
presets.large: big round bulbous tip, wide nostrils
presets.triangle_small: narrow straight nose, small tip, visible bridge
presets.triangle_medium: straight nose with a defined bridge, medium tip; common adult nose
presets.triangle_large: long, wide nose with a strong bridge and broad base
presets.snub_small: short flat small nose, barely projecting
presets.snub_medium: short flat nose with wide soft nostrils
presets.snub_large: short broad flat nose, wide nostrils
presets.upturned_small: small nose with the tip tilted up, nostrils slightly visible
presets.upturned_large: large nose, tip tilted up, wide nostrils

outfit.about: Only visible in poses that show the shoulders or body (not head stickers like thumbs_up's face-only framing). outfit.color = main garment; outfit.color2 = inner shirt, trim, collar or second pattern color; outfit.color3 = small accents (tie, badge, buttons, stripes). Closest matches for common Western clothes: polo shirt -> guayabera (short sleeves, collar) or dressShirt; t-shirt with contrast collar trim -> soccerJersey (V-neck) since crewNeckTshirt shows no trim; jacket over a shirt -> blazer, trackSuit or leatherJacket (color2 = shirt underneath); hoodie -> zipupHoodie.

sideburns.about: Only visible with short or pulled-back hair.

presets.long: long sideburns reaching the earlobe or below

colors.Gray: light silver gray at 0; -0.5 is mid gray (salt and pepper), +0.5 nearly white
colors.Maple: medium chestnut brown; use this for ordinary brown hair
colors.Soft Black: dark brown (it looks clearly brown in renders, not black); use Black for black hair
colors.Black: black; the right pick for black hair, including East and Southeast Asian hair
colors.Golden Brown: ginger / copper orange (despite the label 'Dark Brown'); use for ginger or strawberry hair, not brown
